matrix.requiredContract: Agree untyped XML typed-value/atomization and error behavior against a named profile; do not infer schema typing or full XDM conformance.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: TypedValue uses the one-argument XdmValue.FromString(StringValue); the other schema-name overload exists but is not called by this adapter. Historical 1.34.1 diagnostics are bounded inputs, not a new 1.34.2 proof.

matrix.title: Identity, equality and document order
matrix.requiredContract: Preserve same-snapshot identity and order; state cross-snapshot/generation/document limits explicitly.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: IsSameNode checks its own snapshot first; it returns false for a foreign provider type, otherwise checks the other persistent snapshot and compares snapshot object identity and node ID. matrix.disposition: Existing operations suffice for the declared snapshot-relative profile; no global identity/order promise.

matrix.title: BindResult boundary and detached scalars
matrix.requiredContract: Keep caller snapshot alive through supported lazy access; do not equate guarding an outer result with owning or deep-detaching the graph.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: BindResult returns a new NodeSequence over the supplied sequence, guards outer fetches even for scalar items, and neither acquires a separate snapshot lease nor traverses nested containers. Already copied scalar strings are not revived resources.
matrix.disposition: Existing borrowed-result baseline is a viable requirements direction; joint scope/disposition pending.

consumerEvidence.anchor: foreach (var item in result) yield return item;

matrix.title: Early break, abandonment and cancellation
matrix.requiredContract: State who releases the actual snapshot on completion, early exit, fault, cancellation and abandoned enumeration; never recursively dispose caller values.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: No Dispose or cancellation member exists on the two sequence interfaces. Provider inner iterator Dispose is invoked on normal exhaustion; early break/fault/abandonment does not establish such cleanup. Actual generation admission belongs to the snapshot, not an independently owned per-enumerator lease. Lack of Dispose alone is not proof of a resource leak.
matrix.disposition: Explicit caller snapshot ownership; optional Core result scope only if a demonstrated requirement later demands it.

matrix.title: Nested carriers, maps, arrays and escaped nodes
matrix.requiredContract: Preserve carrier layouts and node references; define graph lifetime through nested/deferred/container/function access and copy/materialization.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: Persistent leaf access validates its original snapshot. BindResult does not recursively wrap, own or detach maps/arrays/functions/external results. Retrieved cached wrappers or containers need not themselves throw; dereferencing the underlying disposed persistent node does.
matrix.disposition: No deep ownership-transfer or recursive-disposal API requested by this audit. Nested/copy behavior needs actual candidate qualification.

matrix.title: Actual snapshot and generation ownership
matrix.requiredContract: Retain the original usable snapshot admission/generation lease until explicit snapshot disposal; coordinator disposal must not release a live snapshot.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: BeginRead acquires a GenerationLease and attaches it to ImmutableXmlSnapshot. Snapshot Dispose marks disposed, clears its caches, nulls and disposes the actual reader lease. Public standalone immutable Open and internal epoch admission have distinct ownership paths; wrapper/sequence creation adds no lease.
matrix.disposition: Keep ownership in XmlDb Storage and the caller; no Core storage dependency or lease/deletion capability.

matrix.title: Query boundary and document loading
matrix.requiredContract: Keep compilation/evaluation and exact same-snapshot document loading usable without provider-specific engine internals.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: Tests use Compile/Evaluate/EvaluateNodes, WithFocus and DocumentLoader; production Xdm assembly directly references only Core. ResolveDocument accepts only the exact stored URI and returns document node 1. Public Evaluate overloads do not themselves grant a general cancellation/lifetime contract.
matrix.disposition: Map the real caller boundary separately from production Core dependencies; candidate/profile/capture qualification remains pending.

matrix.title: Package, implementation and ABI boundary
matrix.requiredContract: Preserve source/unchanged-binary implementers, struct layouts/boxing, enum/default constants and optional slots across an explicitly supported candidate cohort.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: Production Xdm directly uses Core; test/evaluation callers additionally use Api/Providers/Runtime. Storage/Core project dependencies remain independent of engine XDM. All real candidate package/binary qualification is FX009-02, not inferred from this source inventory.
matrix.disposition: No product pin or public interface change; named candidate and final supported replacement modes still need acceptance.

matrix.title: Errors, threading and reentry
matrix.requiredContract: Keep explicit failure boundaries, and do not promise concurrent snapshot disposal, cancellation isolation or reentry merely because metadata is immutable.
matrix.observedCurrentBehavior: Unknown axis, mismatched URI and disposed snapshot have explicit exceptions. Snapshot cache and disposed/lease fields have no general snapshot-level concurrency protocol in the audited type. Sequential tests do not establish every interleaving.
matrix.disposition: Supported sequential scope needs recording; stronger guarantees require a separately designed implementation/qualification.
